memory_candidates: GeneralExistPart implemented with Formula.top/bot + full r-var NF precondition is UNUSABLE at the sorry site because the precondition (nf_eval_nf M (k'+1+1) 2 env sub_nf) is exactly what the proof needs to establish. The Formula.top/bot shortcut proves existence but encodes NO information (trivially true/false temporal truth). The fix requires individual 1-var NF parameters (env_nfs : Fin r -> NF(k+1,1)) with actual temporal formula construction via zone decomposition.

Cross-structure 2-var NF agreement CANNOT be derived from individual 1-var NF agreements + matching order. Counterexample: Z with (0,2) vs (0,1) -- same 1-var NFs at all depths, same order (0<2 and 0<1), but different 2-var NFs (non-empty vs empty between zone). This is documented in NfComposition.lean and confirmed by the v6 plan failure.

For the Kamp theorem ExistPart sorry sites (Until/Since zones with non-constant env), the enriched formula must encode quantifier conditions using temporal formulas that can be evaluated at the Until/Since witness point (x). These formulas must be constructed from individual 1-var NF information (available at x via h_x_agree and at t via h_t_agree), NOT from full 2-var NF information (unavailable and circular).
